networkSegments.name: app-egress
networkSegments.purpose: Preserve application routing to the fixed breach service and operator-selected SMTP and OTLP targets without admitting another deployment service.

networkSegments.name: database
networkSegments.purpose: Restrict PostgreSQL reachability to the runtime and optional setup and migration processes.

networkSegments.name: ingress
networkSegments.purpose: Carry only the reverse proxy to application hop.

networkSegments.name: mail-admin
networkSegments.purpose: Limit mail administration peers to the setup, configuration and narrow certificate-reload helpers; listener authentication remains authoritative because all Stalwart ports are reachable on each attached network.

networkSegments.name: mail-delivery
networkSegments.purpose: Give Stalwart its recipient-delivery route and the operational check its public DNS and SMTP path; all Stalwart listeners remain reachable and protected by their protocol controls.

networkSegments.name: proxy-egress
networkSegments.purpose: Preserve Caddy's ACME route without admitting another deployment service.

networkSegments.name: relay
networkSegments.purpose: Provide the reference SMTP-submission path; every Stalwart listener is reachable, while credentials restrict the application to authenticated mail submission.
